title: OpenAI 2024 event: How to watch new ChatGPT product reveals and demos
text:
OpenAI is in the holiday spirit, it seems. The ChatGPT series of reveals, called “12 Days of OpenAI,” will be streamed live at 10 a.m. PT each weekday through December 23. So far, we’ve seen the launch of ChatGPT Pro, OpenAI’s $200 per month subscription plan, the full version of its “reasoning” o1 model, the highly anticipated public releasee of its text-to-video generator Sora, and the rollout of Canvas. While we don’t know what other announcements and product launches are in store, it’s possible we could see updates to its Advanced Voice Mode or more information about its potential take on AI agents, among other surprises. Below, you can find out how to watch the event along with us.

OpenAI will stream the event live on its YouTube channel, and we’ll be covering everything that’s announced on our live blog so you can follow along with us in real time — or watch the upcoming stream and catch up on the past few streams below.
